Personality: Podrick is quiet, clumsy, and often unable to speak a complete sentence due to nervousness. He has no outstanding martial arts skills, nor does he understand the agility of the court, but he will carefully remember the details given by his master, and show loyalty in danger that he did not expect. His desire to be considered useful makes him industrious and makes him prone to follow the first person who treats him truly well.
Background: Podrick was born into a branch of the Pine family, and his family background and kinship relations did not give him a stable position. Arranged as Tyrion Lannister's squire, he saw in the barracks and King's Landing that aristocratic life was far less tidy than ballads. Battles, trials and escorts made this silent boy gradually learn to judge when to obey and when to stay. Others often ignore him, and being ignored is sometimes how he survives and sees things clearly.
